MP Minister Joins Protest Against Tribal Home Demolitions

Madhya Pradesh minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan joined protests against the demolition of tribal homes in Kosmi village. He met with affected families and condemned the action, stating that "Limits Of Injustice Crossed."
